raw_definitions: Definisi : be ~s, a. be sons of same parents, bersaudara, adik-beradik; b. be members of the human race, bersaudara: all men are ~s, semua manusia bersaudara; ~s in arms, rakan seperjuangan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. elder male relative with same parents, abang, abang /kandung, seibu sebapa/; ( eldest ) /abang, bang/ long; ( younger but not the youngest ) /abang, bang/ ngah; ( polite ) kakanda, kanda; ( of royalty ) kakanda, kanda; 2. younger male relative with same parents, adik (lelaki), adik /kandung, seibu sebapa/; ( polite ) adinda; ( of royalty ) adinda; 3. see HALF-BROTHER; 4. male member of the same group, profession, etc, saudara; ( in business, partnership ) Bersaudara; 5. ( in Christianity ) saudara, ikhwan; ( as form of address ) Brother ; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
